Scene:
发现了夹竹桃有毒。别人看到他，很快给他吃一个灵芝。神农一吃就觉得比较好。然后，他继续写他发现的信息。会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 发现了夹竹桃有毒：it is unclear that夹竹桃refers to黄色的花
- 别人看到他：另外一个人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能不能吃：也会告诉他的朋友哪一个植物能吃，哪个植物不能吃

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 写他发现的信息：写下他发现的信息，写 alone describes the process of writing; 写下 emphasizes recording the information so it is kept. [vocab list]
Run 2: 写他发现的信息：记下他发现的信息，写 only describes producing written text, while 记下 means recording discovered information so it is kept. [vocab list]
Run 3: 写：写下，The verb needs the resultative complement 下 to show that the information is recorded and kept. [vocab list]

output.reason: All runs address the same recording-information wording, and 写下/记下 are acceptable equivalent ways to express recording the information.
